args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST

Essential Items:
- Passport/ID
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap
- Beach towel
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light, breathable clothing
- Rain jacket or poncho
- Insect repellent

Beach & Water Activities:
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach umbrella or canopy
- Water bottle
- Beach toys (if applicable)
- Floating devices (if needed)

Health & Safety:
- First aid kit
- Prescription medications
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes
- Deodorant
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Hairbrush/comb
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Razor and shaving cream
- Feminine hygiene products
- Contact lens supplies (if applicable)

Electronics:
- Camera and extra batteries
- Phone charger and power bank
- Portable speaker
- Universal adapter (if traveling internationally)
- Headphones

Documents:
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservations
- Car rental confirmation (if applicable)
- Activity bookings
- Emergency contacts
- Cash and credit cards

Miscellaneous:
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask
- Earplugs
- Snacks
- Waterproof bag for valuables
- Laundry detergent sheets (if staying longer)
- Laundry bag
- Laundry list of items to wash

Weather Considerations:
- Light layers for air conditioning
- Rain gear
- Sun protection
- Comfortable clothing for warm weather

Remember to check the specific requirements for your activities and duration of stay!
